class.scrapper.name: Scrapper
class.scrapper.style: No gym, no gear, no problem. Builds every workout out of floors, stairs and pure spite. Homemade, held together with tape, and very loud about it.
class.scrapper.loadout: Nothin'. Just you, the floor and the stairs.
class.scrapper.subtitle: BUILT FROM STAIRS AND SPITE
class.bruiser.name: Bargain Bruiser
class.bruiser.style: Kitted out from the clearance aisle. Every piece of gear is store-brand, slightly wobbly and fully committed. Cheap kit, real gains.
class.bruiser.loadout: Two dumbbells, one mat, a kettlebell of unknown origin.
class.bruiser.subtitle: BUY ONE GAIN, GET ONE FREE
class.paladin.name: Plate Paladin
class.paladin.style: Sworn to the barbell. Carries plates like holy relics and drops them like thunder. Big, burly, unbothered.
class.paladin.loadout: A barbell, a rack and a wall of plates.
class.paladin.subtitle: OATH-SWORN TO THE BARBELL
class.cablemancer.name: Cablemancer
class.cablemancer.style: Bends steel cables and pin-stacks to their will. Thin as a wire, strong as the machine. Never waits for the squat rack.
class.cablemancer.loadout: Cables, pin-stacks and every machine in the building.
class.cablemancer.subtitle: SPEAKS FLUENT PULLEY
difficulty.sofa.name: Sofa Mode
difficulty.sofa.line: Never lifted, or not for years. The gentlest workouts.
difficulty.warmup.name: Warm-up Mode
difficulty.warmup.line: A few weeks to a few months in. Easy, steady workouts.
difficulty.sweat.name: Sweat Mode
difficulty.sweat.line: Training most weeks, for about a year. Proper sweaty workouts.
difficulty.pain.name: Pain Mode
difficulty.pain.line: About two years in. Hard workouts, real effort.
difficulty.brutal.name: Brutal Mode
difficulty.brutal.line: Years of serious lifting. Very hard workouts.
difficulty.nightmare.name: Nightmare Mode
difficulty.nightmare.line: Many years, competition level. The hardest workouts there are.
area.riptide.name: Riptide Shore
area.riptide.line: Moonlit sand, a palm island and a treasure chest full of shells.
area.gainsgard.name: Gainsgard Keep
area.gainsgard.line: Cold stone, a flickering torch and a wall that wants scratches.
area.rustbelt.name: Rustbelt Flats
area.rustbelt.line: A striped sunset, a car wreck and barrels that go boom.
area.arcade.name: Arcade Underpass
area.arcade.line: Graffiti, a flickering OPEN 24/7 sign and the PUNCH-O-TRON.
area.frostbite.name: Frostbite Summit
area.frostbite.line: Aurora, falling snow and a slope up to the summit flag.
